result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and signalized control. However, the sidewalk at the corner is significantly narrowed by a large utility box and traffic signal poles, which creates a bottleneck and potential sightline issues.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility box and traffic signal pole significantly narrow the usable sidewalk width at the corner, creating a bottleneck for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The placement of the utility box and large pole at the corner may partially block the visibility of pedestrians, especially children, from the perspective of turning motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility box to a position that does not obstruct the primary pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel line crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental markings.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban corridor with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a signalized intersection. Pedestrian safety is compromised by narrow walkways obstructed by utility poles and parked vehicles that limit sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and signage are placed within the narrow sidewalk, reducing the effective width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility.

result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, safety is reduced by the lack of daylighting at the corners, where parked vehicles obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners block the view of pedestrians for approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides adjacent to the crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk, improving visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including a sidewalk, curb ramp with tactile paving, and a pedestrian signal. However, the lack of marked crosswalk lines and the presence of debris on the walkway reduce the overall safety and comfort for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Piles of trash and debris are located on the sidewalk near the pedestrian signal pole, creating a potential tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom right foreground on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a curb ramp and pedestrian signal, there are no painted crosswalk markings on the roadway to alert drivers to the crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway adjacent to the red tactile paving

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.
